scope: Every archive file allowed by .gitignore; .git metadata excluded. Raw bytes include binaries; gzip and tgz streams are also scanned after decompression. Nested formats inside those streams are not recursively unpacked.
method: Python byte scan. Case-insensitive path/name matching; case-sensitive credential prefixes; bounded ASCII email syntax. Every occurrence is listed, including overlapping rules. Line numbers are one-based; byte offsets are zero-based within the named stream. No matched private values are copied into this report.
self_check: This report is scanned after generation and contains zero matches. SOURCE_SHA256.json is rescanned after regeneration; neither artifact embeds its own hash.

redactions.action: Two runner-profile prefixes replaced by <LOCAL>; all other bytes unchanged
